key_terms: One try at running a task instance. A retry starts a new attempt and does not roll back external effects of the earlier one.
The configured number of retries and delay that Airflow applies after a task attempt fails.
Writing one deterministic partition per validated day so that repeating the same logical write produces the same output rather than appended duplicates.
Writing a complete temporary file, flushing it and renaming it over the target path, so readers see either the old file or the new one. It covers one local file, not several systems.
evidence: Project-only actual product commands with independent fixture oracles. Source preparation, native runtime observations and restart evidence are recorded separately in the workshop qualification ledger.
